Additional m11, m39, m191, m201, m198, and m208 points target separate V1/V2 and loading behavior in late-tail regimes. m31, m200, m173, m209, m115, m166, and m38 extend coverage to functional-group combinations and structural neighborhoods that are sparse or poorly transferred.
